tex_content.html:
If $\Ric \le (n-1)K$, then \begin{equation} {\dist _{t_1}(x_0,x_1)\over \dist _{t_0}(x_0,x_1)}\ge e^{-(n-1)K(t_1-t_0)}\quad (t_1>t_0). \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch For any curve, $dL/dt=-\int \Ric (\dot\gamma ,\dot\gamma )/|\dot\gamma |\, ds\ge -(n-1)KL$; integrate and minimize at $t_1$.

□
Remark
[structural remark on length distortion estimates]
